Rules: Your divine body exceeds mortal capability. Gain Advantage on Strength checks made to lift, push, pull, force open doors, bend bars, break chains or destroy mundane objects. You count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity only. Your Scale does not increase.
Domains: Strength, Valor, War, Glory, Protection, Zeal

Rules: Once you have successfully identified a creature's tracks or scent, you always know the approximate direction it travelled while it remains within 10 km.
Domains: Hunt, Wilderness, Beasts, Nature, Travel, Secrets

Rules: You ignore difficult footing caused by ice, mud, rubble, ship rigging, ropes and narrow ledges. Gain Advantage on checks made to avoid falling or losing balance.
Domains: Balance, Air, Travel, Sky, Freedom, Protection

Rules: Gain Advantage on Medicine checks made to stabilize creatures or treat wounds. Treating Bruised wounds takes half the normal time.
Domains: Healing, Mercy, Life, Love, Peace, Renewal

Rules: After examining an object for one minute, immediately determine its quality, weak points, repair history and approximate value. Gain Advantage when identifying crafted objects.
Domains: Craft, Metal, Knowledge, Creation, Earth, Wisdom

Rules: Once during each social encounter, after failing a Charisma check, immediately reroll it. You must keep the second result.
Domains: Love, Trade, Nobility, Deception, Trickery, Beauty

Rules: You instinctively feel active divine power, lingering spirits, curses and magical effects within roughly 20 metres. This reveals presence, not precise location.
Domains: Magic, Spirit, Secrets, Knowledge, Twilight, Souls

Rules: Natural animals start friendlier toward you. Hostile animals hesitate before attacking unless magically controlled, starving or protecting offspring.
Domains: Nature, Beasts, Wilderness, Hunt, Growth, Peace

Rules: Gain Advantage on Saving Throws against fear, intimidation and supernatural terror.
Domains: Valor, Glory, Will, War, Strength, Zeal

Rules: You consume only half the normal food and water. Poor rations count as adequate for recovering Fatigue.
Domains: Harvest, Hearth, Life, Earth, Renewal, Nature

Rules: Ignore penalties from rain, smoke, fog and double your visual distance when making Perception checks. Dim light counts as bright light for vision-based checks.
Domains: Sky, Sun, Knowledge, Light, Air, Twilight

Rules: Creatures trying to determine whether you are lying through non magical means have to do so with disadvantage as long as your lies are well crafted and subtle
Domains: Deception, Trickery, Secrets, Shadow, Chaos, Wealth

Rules: Gain Advantage on Stealth checks while in dim light or darkness. If motionless for one round, creatures must first succeed on a Perception check to notice you.
Domains: Shadow, Darkness, Moon, Twilight, Secrets, Trickery

Rules: Increase your movement by proficiency bonus metres.
Domains: Travel, Freedom, Air, Sky, Storms, Zeal

Rules: Gain Advantage on Saving Throws against poison, disease, alcohol and naturally occurring toxins.
Domains: Blood, Life, Strength, Healing, Earth, Protection

Rules: Gain Advantage on Saving Throws against magical charms, compulsions and emotional manipulation.
Domains: Wisdom, Balance, Order, Peace, Will, Protection

Rules: When your group completes a Rest inside a Safe Space that you helped establish, every ally removes one additional Wound
Domains: Hearth, Peace, Renewal, Life, Healing, Protection

Rules: Produce a harmless magical effect fitting one of your domains. It cannot inflict wounds or grant combat bonuses.
Domains: Magic, Creation, Spirit, Light, Chaos, Trickery

Rules: You always know the cardinal directions and cannot become naturally lost.
Domains: Air, Travel, Sky, Storms, Freedom, Knowledge

Rules: Twice per day, reroll a natural 1 made on any non-combat d20 roll.
Domains: Luck, Fortune, Fate, Chaos, Trickery, Travel

Rules: You cannot be knocked prone and have advantage on saves against being moved against your will.
Domains: Earth, Protection, Strength, Metal, Valor, Will

Rules: Gain Advantage when attempting to detect disguises, illusions, forged documents or deliberate deception.
Domains: Justice, Light, Wisdom, Law, Order, Knowledge

Rules: Communicate simple concepts with non-magical animals.
Domains: Beasts, Nature, Wilderness, Hunt, Spirit, Freedom

Rules: Drawing, swapping or sheathing weapons never requires your Minor Action.
Domains: War, Freedom, Zeal, Metal, Craft, Passion

Rules: Gain Advantage on your first Attack Roll of combat.
Domains: War, Glory, Storms, Wrath, Valor, Vengeance

Rules: You can breathe under water. Gain Advantage on swimming checks.
Domains: Oceans, Water, Life, Travel, Frost, Nature

Rules: Mundane fire and extreme heat never cause Fatigue or discomfort.
Domains: Fire, Sun, Light, Creation, Destruction, Hearth

Rules: Mundane cold never causes Fatigue or discomfort.
Domains: Frost, Water, Oceans, Darkness, Protection, Shadow

Rules: Automatically sense nearby undead, ghosts and lingering souls within roughly 30 metres.
Domains: Death, Souls, Spirit, Shadow, Twilight, Secrets

Rules: You can spend 4 hours meditating on a place to make plants bloom, fruit grow, and natural environment heal for 50m radius around you.
Domains: Growth, Renewal, Nature, Life, Harvest, Earth

Rules: Once you've seen a creature bleed, gain Advantage on all attempts to track it until it finishes a long rest.
Domains: Blood, Hunt, Wilderness, Vengeance, Death, Beasts

Rules: Identify structural weaknesses, hidden entrances and collapse points in buildings/caves after one minute of study.
Domains: Creation, Craft, Civilization, Earth, Metal, Knowledge

Rules: Gain Advantage on checks made to organize crowds, command guards or maintain order outside combat.
Domains: Law, Nobility, Order, Civilization, Justice, War

Rules: Get advantage on any rolls to travel through difficult terrain/long arduous roads. Additionally get aadvantage on any checks made to resist being moved against your will
Domains: Travel, Fortune, Luck, Fate, Freedom, Air

Rules: Natural darkness under moonlight counts as bright light for you.
Domains: Moon, Twilight, Shadow, Darkness, Sky, Hunt

Rules: You instantly recognize the sigils, houses, and financial backing of anyone presenting themselves as nobility or wealthy elite. You gain Advantage on checks made to spot high-society imposters or to leverage your own perceived status during formal galas and courtly intrigue.
Domains: Trade, Wealth, Knowledge, Civilization, Fortune, Luck

Rules: Once per short rest when you succeed on a Saving Throw against fear, charm or compulsion, recover 1 PotD.
Domains: Zeal, Passion, Will, Light, Fire, Strength

Rules: Allies within conversation distance gain Advantage on Saving Throws against despair, surrender and hopelessness.
Domains: Mercy, Peace, Light, Life, Love, Protection

Rules: Gain Advantage on climbing checks. Climbing no longer costs double movement unless the surface is nearly vertical and smooth.
Domains: Earth, Freedom, Wilderness, Strength, Travel, Beasts

Rules: You may attempt Medicine checks to stabilize/treat a creature as a Minor Action instead of a Major Action.
Domains: Healing, War, Mercy, Life, Blood, Peace

Rules: Gain Advantage on checks requiring careful manual precision such as lock mechanisms, surgery or delicate craftsmanship.
Domains: Craft, Wisdom, Knowledge, Metal, Creation, Beauty

Rules: Creatures have Disadvantage to detect you by sight while you remain motionless in darkness.
Domains: Darkness, Shadow, Secrets, Moon, Twilight, Death

Rules: Mundane darkness within 2 metres of you is softly illuminated. Allies recognize you instinctively even through disguises.
Domains: Light, Sun, Glory, Fire, Protection, Life

Rules: Gain Advantage on Survival checks made to locate food, fresh water or medicinal herbs.
Domains: Harvest, Nature, Wilderness, Growth, Life, Hunt

Rules: Whenever you fail a Saving Throw against fear or charm, you may spend 1 PotD to reroll it.
Domains: Will, Zeal, Wisdom, Strength, Valor, Order

Rules: Any Ritual you assist with requires half the normal casting time.
Domains: Magic, Knowledge, Spirit, Time, Creation, Secrets

Rules: Once per day ask the GM one yes-or-no question representing guidance from ancestral spirits. The answer must be truthful but may be cryptic.
Domains: Souls, Death, Wisdom, Knowledge, Spirit, Fortune, Time, Fate

Rules: After spending ten minutes among a crowd, you gain Advantage on checks to gather rumors or identify influential locals.
Domains: Civilization, Love, Trade, Secrets, Deception, Trickery

Rules: Whenever combat begins, creatures who have already seen you fight recognize your dangerous reputation. The GM may rule weak-willed enemies hesitate before engaging you.
Domains: Wrath, War, Passion, Valor, Vengeance, Strength

Rules: Repairing mundane equipment requires half the normal materials and time.
Domains: Creation, Craft, Hearth, Metal, Earth, Civilization

Rules: Gain Advantage on checks made to conceal information, hidden compartments or secret messages.
Domains: Secrets, Deception, Knowledge, Trickery, Shadow, Darkness

Rules: Sleeping outdoors counts as sleeping in comfortable conditions for recovering Fatigue/Wounds, provided the environment is not supernatural/specifically dangerous
Domains: Nature, Growth, Hearth, Wilderness, Life, Peace

Rules: You always know approximately how much time has passed since sunrise and sunset and the shortest route back to any place you last came from.
Domains: Travel, Time, Sky, Moon, Air, Knowledge

Rules: Mortals inherently recognize your divine nature. You gain Advantage on Charisma checks against mortals of Scale 1 or lower who are not actively hostile toward you.
Inspect an item, passage, structure, or object and gain advantage on any checks to determine if it has been actively or magically tampered with or changed in the last week
You ignore difficult terrain in natural environments (forests, swamps, rocky crags). Additionally, you have Advantage on checks made to resist being moved or Tripped while standing on natural earth.
Emanate a chilling dread. Target a mortal of Scale 1 or lower within Close range. They must pass a Wisdom save or lose their Minor Action on their next turn due to shivering fear (Daze).

You can seamlessly weave minor enchantments into your speech. Once per short rest, if you are caught in a lie, you may immediately reroll the deception check, provided you incorporate a half-truth into the new statement.
Once per short rest, when an attack against you beats your defence by 15-19, you suffer the 2 Wounds but may choose to ignore the Incapacitated condition.
Manipulate up to 10 litres of water per turn, freezing or shaping it into simple tools (a key, a dagger, a cup) that last for 10 minutes before melting or losing shape.
You constantly perceive echoes of the immediate future. You cannot be surprised in combat, and you may spend 2 PotD to give one attack disadvantage. You can use this feature once per short rest
Choose one non-combat skill. You automatically succeed at mundane tasks involving it unless dramatically impossible.
Mortals naturally assume you are sent by your divine parent. Gain Advantage on first impressions unless acting against their interests.
By touching flowing water you witness echoes of the last hour that occurred there. Never perfect, always symbolic.
Ignore all mundane fall damage under 20m and always land standing.
Camps you oversee cannot be surprised by natural predators or weather.
Gain Advantage when commanding crowds during emergencies.
Sense divine artifacts or sacred places within 100m.
Instantly repair a mundane object no larger than a cart.
Ignore difficult terrain caused by plants, sand or snow.
You instantly know whether someone is lying through omission or hidden burden, but not the truth itself.
You never suffer illness from spoiled food or water.
Ignite or extinguish non-magical flames within Near range.
Perfectly remember any conversation heard within the last month.
You gain advantage on interactions with ghosts, spirits and undead, and can ask one truthfully answered question per day.
Carry twice your normal capacity without slowing.
Predict weather 24 hours in advance with near-perfect accuracy.
Your physical body does not show signs of aging, weariness, or decay. You always look like you are in the peak of your youth, and you recover from minor physical fatigue twice as fast.
Domains: Youth, Life, Beauty, Renewal, Healing, Protection

Rules: You are completely immune to all mundane diseases, contagions, and parasites. You can instinctively identify the source of any infection or plague within Near range.
Domains: Plague, Blood, Ruin, Death, Protection, Wilderness

Rules: You can perfectly replicate any sound, instrument tune, or voice you have heard within the past week. You gain Advantage on performance checks involving singing or playing musical instruments and immitating other voices.
Domains: Music, Passion, Beauty, Civilization, Freedom, Chaos

Rules: Non-magical, unattended mundane items made of wood, cloth, or leather decay and become brittle or ruined three times as fast when left in your continuous personal possession for over an hour. Additionally you can spend one PotD to instantly destroy a handheld non magical item.
Children and young animals are instinctively drawn to you and trust you completely. Unless caught in a flagrant act of aggression, NPCs assume you are an innocent bystander rather than a threat.
Domains: Youth, Growth, Life, Deception, Trickery, Peace, Mercy

Rules: You can move at your normal speed while naturally asleep without tripping, falling, or striking obstacles. As long as you are navigating along a safe, familiar path, you can travel entirely by instinct.
Domains: Dreams, Travel, Void, Fate, Protection, Twilight

Rules: When you sing or play a mournful melody, lingering spirits, ghosts, and undead within 30 metres become calm and passive unless directly attacked. You can additionally attempt to coerce a spirit to move on to their atual rest by making a succesful performance check(DM's discretion)
Domains: Music, Death, Souls, Spirit, Shadow, Secrets

Rules: Your touch accelerates spoilage. With a Touch you can instantly spoil a week's worth of rations, sour a keg of wine, or cause a small puddle of water to become completely unpotable and disease-ridden. Anyone consuming items tainted by you gains 1 point of Fatigue instead of nourishment.
Domains: Plague, Ruin, Water, Oceans, Trickery, Deception, Blood

Rules: You leave no footprints, scent, or heat signature behind when moving through barren, empty, or desolate terrain (such as deserts, salt flats, or rocky voids).
Domains: Void, Wilderness, Shadow, Secrets, Air, Sky

Rules: Your eyes flash and you point to an unattended mundane object no larger than a wooden chest, instantly sundering it or cleanly breaking its locks, hinges, or joints.
Domains: Destruction, Ruin, Craft, Metal, Earth, Strength

Rules: You gain Advantage on Insight and Investigation checks made to determine if a written contract or verbal agreement has been violated, or contains hidden, deceptive loopholes.
Domains: Law, Order, Justice, Nobility, Knowledge, Civilization, Wisdom

Rules: By looking at two mortals simultaneously, you can instinctively recognize if they share a direct blood relation. You gain Advantage on checks regarding noble lineages and historical genealogies.
Domains: Blood, Nobility, Civilization, Knowledge, Time, Life

Rules: You instantly determine the exact market value, material purity, and authenticity of any currency, gemstone, or precious metal. Merchants respect your gaze, giving you Advantage on trade negotiations.
Domains: Wealth, Trade, Fortune, Luck, Metal, Civilization

Rules: Torrential rain, gale-force winds, and snowstorms do not impose Disadvantage on your physical or ranged attack rolls. You always remain completely dry in light rain unless you choose otherwise.
Domains: Storms, Sky, Air, Water, Protection, Oceans

Rules: Once per short rest, when an enemy scores a critical hit against you or an ally within Near range, your next attack roll against that specific enemy gains Advantage.
Domains: Vengeance, Wrath, War, Valor, Justice, Passion

Rules: Your physical presence and artistic movements are uniquely captivating. You gain Advantage on Charisma checks to persuade or charm individuals who appreciate fine arts, fashion, music, or beauty, or when putting on a perormance in which you are proficient
Domains: Beauty, Love, Passion, Music, Nobility, Civilization

Rules: When performing tasks requiring precise mathematical division (like splitting loot, rations, or measuring weights), you do so flawlessly and instantly. Additionally you have advantage on any checks regarding a city/persons finances or economy.
Domains: Balance, Order, Law, Justice, Trade, Wealth

Rules: Emit a sudden flash of brilliant solar light. Enemies within Close range must succeed on a Con save or suffer Disadvantage on their next physical attack roll due to being dazzled.
Domains: Sun, Light, Sky, Fire, Glory, Destruction

Rules: Your touch can sap heat rapidly. You can instantly freeze up to a cup of water, preserve perishable food from spoiling for twice as long, or coat a handheld object in thin, non-magical frost.
Domains: Frost, Water, Oceans, Darkness, Shadow, Hearth

Rules: When clearing crops, harvesting flora, or chopping wood, you do so at triple the normal speed. You can instantly tell if a plant or crop is poisonous, diseased, or perfectly ripe by touching it.
Domains: Harvest, Nature, Growth, Earth, Death, Ruin

Rules: You always win mundane games of pure chance (like coin flips or simple dice rolls) against ordinary mortals, unless they use cheating mechanisms or magical intervention.
Domains: Luck, Fortune, Fate, Trickery, Deception, Wealth, Chaos

Rules: Withered, dead, or diseased plants slowly revive and grow healthy if left within your personal living quarters or camp over a short rest. Small flowers sprout in your footsteps when you travel through fertile soil. Spending extended time in the same place makes the flora grow expansively
Domains: Youth, Growth, Renewal, Nature, Life, Harvest

Rules: Your presence acts like a psychological contagion. When a mortal within Near range fails a save against fear or intimidation, any ally standing adjacent to them must immediately roll their next fear save with Disadvantage.
Domains: Plague, Wrath, Vengeance, Will, Secrets, Darkness

Rules: The rhythm of your footsteps can sync with ambient sounds. While an instrument is being played or you are actively humming a tune, you and allies within conversation distance gain Advantage on checks made to march or travel long distances without getting fatigued.

Your thoughts are an empty, silent abyss. You are completely immune to non-magical attempts to read your posture, expressions, or intentions, and you have advantage on checks against magical attempts to read your mind.
Domains: Void, Secrets, Will, Deception, Shadow, Darkness

Rules: Your physical attacks and tools/weapons deal double structural damage to inanimate barricades, doors, walls, gates, and fortifications.
Domains: Ruin, Destruction, War, Strength, Metal, Earth

Rules: Mundane riding beasts and predators exhibit an unsettling dread when you look into their eyes. They will never willingly attack you unless forced, and you can ride them through terrifying conditions without them panicking.
Domains: Dreams, Beasts, Wilderness, Hunt, Shadow, Darkness

Rules: When you successfully stabilize or treat a creature's wounds, their physical appearance temporarily becomes rejuvenated, clearing up minor blemishes and dirt and making them appear in their absolute prime youth for the next 24 hours.
Domains: Youth, Growth, Life, Renewal, Healing, Beauty

Rules: When you witness a creature flagrantly breaking a local law, decree, or solemn oath, your righteous anger flares. You gain Advantage on your first Intimidation or Attack roll against that creature within the hour.
Domains: Law, Order, Justice, Wrath, Vengeance, Will

Rules: By touching a mortal creature, you can induce a mild, brief fever or bout of coughing that lasts for 10 minutes. While it causes no mechanical combat penalties, it makes them look visibly unwell and sluggish.
The moment the first rays of the morning sun touch your skin, you feel an instant rush of vigor. Once per day at dawn, you can instantly clear one point of Fatigue OR one Wound without resting.
Domains: Sun, Light, Youth, Growth, Hearth, Renewal, Life

Rules: You can safely consume entirely spoiled, putrid, or insect-infested food and diseased carcass material that would normally incapacitate or poison a mortal. You derive full nourishment from it and suffer no ill effects.
Domains: Plague, Death, Hunt, Beasts, Wilderness, Blood

Rules: Light your hand with a small flame, providing dim light within Close range and the ability to slowly ignite tinder, burn through thin ropes, or warm a small meal without burning yourself.
Manifest a floating, translucent hand to safely manipulate, push, pull, or carry objects up to 10 lbs within Medium range for the duration of a scene.
Instantly mold a small patch of loose dirt, sand, or clay into simple shapes, or completely clear a small 5-meter campsite of uncomfortable debris and rocks.
Arrest a dangerous fall. You immediately lose your downward momentum and float gently to the ground, taking no fall damage.
A subtle visual shimmer or intuitive tug gently guides you toward the very next step of your immediate quest, acting as a momentary, mystical compass to your objective.
The rustling leaves, wind currents, and ambient animal calls subconsciously direct you toward the nearest source of safe drinking water, natural shelter, or edible forage.
As part of a ritual consisting of you creating a small object, you may increase  the value of the item x5 without the excess material components
Hostile creatures with low intelligence or animalistic instincts will instinctively hesitate, preventing them from targeting you first during the opening round of a combat encounter unless provoked.
When attempting a Strength check to lift, break, or force open a mundane object, you may instantly channel divine energy to add a flat +5 to your final check result.
Touch a single container of water (up to a waterskin or small bucket in size) and completely purify it, instantly removing all natural poisons, dirt, and diseases.
Instantly snuff out all non-magical flames within a 10-meter radius of yourself, shrouding the immediate area in total darkness.
Your grip strength is supernaturally reinforced. You cannot be forcibly disarmed of your weapon, shield, or an object you are holding by any mundane, non-magical means.
Communicate a single, simple concept or question to a non-magical animal and receive a basic emotional response or a one-word conceptual answer in return.
You always know the exact time of day, the cardinal directions, and exactly how many hours remain until the next sunrise or sunset, even while deep underground or blinded.
You are completely immune to the negative environmental effects of extreme cold weather and snow blindness, though you still take cold damage from direct attacks normally.
Make a small handheld object (like a coin, gem, or key) appear and feel exactly like a different object of similar size and weight for up to one hour.
You can track the presence of actively bleeding or injured creatures (suffering a Bloodied wound or worse) within a 30-meter radius, even through solid walls.
Magically repair a single tear, break, or fracture in a mundane, non-magical object that fits in the palm of your hand, completely restoring its physical integrity.
Touch an inanimate object to receive a fleeting, blurry, one-second visual vision of the last living creature that held or used it.

Immediately make one additional Attack Roll against a creature already within your weapon's range. This attack follows all normal combat rules and may trigger weapon effects. You may only use Heroic Surge once each turn.
Domains: War, Valor, Strength, Time, Wrath, Zeal

Rules: Leap up to 15 metres horizontally or 8 metres vertically without requiring a check. This movement ignores terrain and does not provoke attacks granted by entering weapon range. You suffer no falling damage from this leap. You can make an attack as part of this leap.
Touch a creature and reduce one of its Wounds by one stage (Broken → Bloodied, Bloodied→ Bruised, Bruised → Healthy). A creature may only benefit once per short rest or take a level of fatigue
One creature you can see gains +3 Defence Bonus until the beginning of your next turn. This stacks with armour and shields.
After successfully hitting with a weapon attack, increase your result on the Damage Table by +4 before wounds are determined.
Domains: Wrath, Valor, War, Light, Vengeance, Sun

Rules: When an attack hits and you would suffer wounds from the Damage Table, reduce the attack's margin by 3(min 1 wound) before applying wounds and effects.
Immediately move up to half your movement when targeted by an attack/area of effect. If this places you outside the weapon's range before the attack is resolved, the attack automatically misses.
Choose one creature that can hear you. It must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or immediately obey a simple one-word command that does not directly cause self-harm.

While in dim light or darkness, the shadows swallow you up. Until you attack or use another Major Action that draws attention, creatures have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you unless they possess supernatural sight.
Domains: Shadow, Darkness, Secrets, Moon, Twilight, Trickery

Rules: Plants erupt in a 5 metre area. Creatures inside must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity Saving Throw or become Grappled. Escaping follows the normal Grapple rules.
Choose a small area within sight. Every creature inside makes a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Ability DC. Failure resolves on the Damage Table.
Lightning strikes a visible creature or location. Resolve using the Damage Table. Targets wearing heavy metal armour suffer Disadvantage on the Saving Throw if one is allowed.
Raise a stone wall roughly 10 metres long, 3 metres high and 30 cm thick. It counts as Total Cover until destroyed or the scene ends.
Speak with a lingering soul for up to one minute. The spirit behaves as it would in life, perhaps with some deathly quirks
Enter the dreams of a sleeping creature you touch. You may converse, observe memories or leave symbolic messages. This causes no direct harm.
One ally that you touch gains the ability to reroll one ability check, saving throw or attack roll for the next 24 hours. Does not stack.
Allies within 10 metres gain Advantage on all Attack Roll before your next turn.
Move your full movement before and after making one Attack Roll. This movement ignores attacks granted by entering weapon ranges.
Mark one creature you can see. Until the end of the scene you always know its direction while on the same plane, and gain +2 to Attack Rolls against it.
End one curse, fear effect, magical silence/blindness or illusion affecting a creature you touch.
Push every creature in a 15m line centered on you up to 10 metres in a parralel line(like a wave). Creatures failing a Strength Saving Throw are also Knocked Prone and dazed
A creature that knowingly lies to you before the end of the scene immediately suffers one Bruised wound unless it succeeds on a Wisdom Saving Throw.
Inflict supernatural sickness on a creature you touch. Until cured, the target has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws and Medicine checks, and suffers from clearly looking sick.
Instantly repair or create one mundane weapon or tool from nearby raw materials matching the right value and type. Items are forged as standard quality.
Domains: Craft, Metal, Creation, Earth, Fire, Civilization

Rules: Slam the ground. Every creature within 5m radius of you is pushed 10m away and must succeed on a Dexterity Saving Throw or become Prone and the ground around you becomes difficult terrain
Until the end of your next short or long rest, your movement ignores difficult terrain and you may move across water or vertical surfaces provided you do not end your turn there.
When a melee attack against you misses, immediately make one Attack Roll against that creature. This attack follows all normal weapon rules.
When an ally within 2 metres would take damage, move adjacent to them and both of you gain the benefits of the Brace action until the attack resolves.
Choose one ally that can hear you. They may immediately move up to half their movement without provoking weapon range attacks.
Move your full movement in a straight line before making an attack. If you hit, increase the Damage Table result by +3.
Domains: Hunt, Beasts, Wilderness, Strength, Blood, Passion

Rules: When you successfully hit with a melee weapon, you can enact the stagger effect on enemies and push them 5 meters back if they fail a strength saving throw.
When targeted by a ranged weapon attack, reduce the attack margin by 3 before resolving the Damage Table. If this does no damage, catch the projectile if it is able to be realistically caught.
Domains: Air, Balance, Protection, Sky, Metal, Freedom

Rules: Move at least 5 metres directly toward a creature before attacking. If you hit, the target is automatically Pushed 2 metres and Tripped.
Domains: Strength, War, Wrath, Valor, Zeal, Vengeance

Rules: After hitting a creature, choose another creature within 2 metres of the original target. Resolve an attack against it using the same Attack Roll.
While adjacent to an ally, enemies suffer Disadvantage when attacking that ally if they could legally attack you instead.
Domains: Protection, Mercy, Valor, Love, Peace, Life

Rules: Whenever a creature disengages, retreats or moves away from you, increase your movement by 4 metres until the end of your next turn.
Domains: Hunt, Travel, Zeal, Blood, Vengeance, Freedom

Rules: Until the end of your next short or long rest, you can see invisible creatures, magical disguises and active illusions within 20 metres.
Create a 5m radius area of divine protection. Allies inside gain Advantage on Saving Throws against fear, curses, spirits, and spell effects.
Domains: Life, Light, Peace, Protection, Healing, Hearth

Rules: Fill a small area with supernatural smoke. Creatures inside have Disadvantage on ranged attacks and Perception checks relying on sight.
Creatures that can hear you must make a Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure they cannot willingly make Attack Rolls until they are attacked or the scene changes.
Domains: Peace, Mercy, Love, Order, Balance, Civilization

Rules: Whenever your attack Incapacitates or kills a creature, immediately move up to half your movement without spending an action/provoking opportunity attacks.
Instead of normal movement, you can consume your minor action and instantly step between two areas of dim light or darkness up to Far range.
Make a standard Attack Roll. On a success, add +3 to your margin over defence, and automatically trigger the Push effect (2 metres), regardless of the weapon being used.
Make a melee Attack Roll. If you successfully deal at least 1 Wound to a creature that has blood, you siphon their vitality, immediately healing 1 of your Wounds.
Create a perfect, intangible clone of yourself within Close range that lasts for 1 minute. It mimics your movements and can draw enemy aggro, forcing enemies to guess which target is real.
When you or an ally within Near range is attacked, summon a blinding ward. Grant a +3 Defence Bonus against that single attack, potentially negating it entirely.

Transform entirely into a Scale 1 beast for up to 1 hour. You gain their physical stats, movement speed, and natural weapons, while retaining your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma. When using this feature you can not use your PotD
Allies within Near range ignore Fear and gain Advantage on their next save.
Instantly cross any mundane obstacle under 20m without interacting with it.
Create a 5m sacred area where Fatigue cannot increase for one scene.
Know whether one visible creature knowingly committed the crime being discussed.
Permanently improve a mundane crafted item with one narrative quality.
Move or calm a large body of water within Near range.
Swear an oath. While pursuing it, regain 1 PotD the first time each day you suffer a Wound.
Send a spoken message across any distance to someone you have met.
Ask the GM one question about the immediate future. Answer is symbolic but truthful.
Instantly move adjacent to an ally suffering a Wound.
Shape stone, roots or ice into a stable crossing.
Create enough wholesome food for twenty people.
Freeze the ground beneath a target within Near range. The target must pass a Strength Saving Throw or have their movement speed reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.
Whenever a creature hits you with a melee weapon attack, they suffer an automatic Bruised wound from sharp spectral growths.
For the next hour, you can perfectly speak, read, and understand any spoken or written language or dialect you encounter.
Create a heavy gravitational field in a 5m radius area. Flying creatures within the area are immediately forced to the ground, and jumping is impossible inside it.
Unleash a burst of blinding sunlight. All enemies within 5 metres must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or be blinded, suffering Disadvantage on all Attack Rolls until your next turn.
Summon a spirit hound that lasts for one scene. It cannot attack, but it automatically tracks the scent of any creature you name, tracking them flawlessly across any terrain.

Touch a mundane object up to 1m squared. Permanently convert a portion of it into solid gold or precious gems worth up to a standard merchant's weekly income. The object changes back from gold after 24 hours. You can use this feature once per short rest.

Sing a mesmerizing melody. Up to three targets within Near range must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or become Charmed by you until they take damage or the scene ends. Charmed targets will step forward to shield you from attacks.
Channel life energy into the ground. A 5m radius area blooms with vibrant, breathtaking flora. Allies within the area instantly clear 1 level of Fatigue and heal one Bruised wound.
Domains: Youth, Growth, Renewal, Healing, Life, Beauty

Rules: Summon a patch of absolute zero void within Near range (3m radius). Light cannot penetrate it. Any creature starting its turn inside takes a Bruised wound and has its movement halved due to crushing gravity and cold.

When you or an adjacent ally are targeted by an attack, manifest a shield of dense black ice. Increase Defence Bonus by +4 against that attack. If the attack misses, the attacker's weapon or limbs are frozen, giving them Disadvantage on their next physical roll.

Exude an aura of undeniable authority. Until the end of the next round, any creature attempting to attack you directly must first pass a Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, they must choose a different target or waste their action.

Conjure a pack of spectral wolves to harry a target within Near range. The target is immediately Flanked and suffers Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws. Any physical attack against the target deals +2 damage for the next 3 rounds.

Project a dream-like illusion of a hazard (e.g., a chasm or wall of fire) up to 5m wide. Enemies who see it must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or believe it is completely real, refusing to cross it or wasting actions trying to bypass it.

Spend an hour blessing a farm, market, or community stockpile. For the next month, food production doubles, spoilage drops to zero, and any commercial transactions within the area yield 20% more profit.

After successfully hitting a creature with a ranged or melee attack, freeze them in a localized time pocket until the end of your next round. The target cannot take any actions, move, or be harmed until the start of your next turn.

Condense ambient moisture into a crushing undercurrent that sweeps through a 15m line. All affected creatures are pulled up to 10m toward you and must succeed on a Strength Saving Throw or be pinned Prone under crushing gravity and water weight.
Domains: Oceans, Water, Storms, Strength, Travel, Void

Rules: Infuse a draft using your essence. A creature drinking this is cured of all non-magical diseases/poisons, and has their physical appearance and vigor restored to their absolute prime for 24 hours, removing all fatigue ad up to one wound.

When a living creature dies within Near range, capture its parting energy. Direct it to either instantly restore 1 Wound to an ally within Close range, or form a fleeting spiritual shield that grants an ally +3 Defence for 1 round.

Play a soothing arrangement that pacifies aggressive impulses. All hostile creatures within 10 meters must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw vs DC-5 or lower their weapons. Fighting ceases immediately unless a creature is directly attacked.
You possess supernatural commercial luck. You can always find a willing buyer for any item, acquire goods at a 25% discount.

Channel a brilliant flash of architectural or blacksmithing inspiration. For the next hour, you and any allies assisting you work at 5x normal speed, use half the required raw materials, and produce masterwork-quality tools or defenses.

Flash-freeze a massive body of water or a 15-meter area of land. The surface becomes slick, treacherous sheet ice. Creatures moving through it must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or fall Prone, and any fire effects in the area are instantly snuffed out.

When you hit an organic creature or plant monster, convert your weapon's impact into an organic rot. The target takes +3 damage, and their biological functions wither, rendering them unable to heal or regenerate any wounds until the end of combat.

Unleash a kaleidoscopic explosion of shifting dreamscapes around you. All enemies facing you must make a Wisdom Saving Throw or become transfixed by the sublime beauty, losing their next Minor Action and suffering Disadvantage on attacks.

Play a wild flute melody to invoke a surge of raw primeval energy. For the next hour, local non-sentient wildlife reverts to its energetic prime, plants grow exponentially to form dense cover, and tracking rolls against you suffer Disadvantage.
Domains: Youth, Growth, Moon, Beasts, Wilderness, Music

Rules: Create a localized miniature gravity well at a spot you see within Near range. All loose items and enemies within 5m are yanked toward the center on a failed Strength save. This lasts for 5 minutes or until you dispel it. Do not let it grow to large

Sing a rousing song that channels blinding magnificence. All allies within 10 meters gain a +2 bonus their next(1) Attack Roll and are cured of the Blinded or Shaken conditions. Enemies looking at you suffer Disadvantage on attacks due to your radiant performance.

Perform a hauntingly beautiful melody that induces a peaceful, regenerative slumber. One willing or incapacitated creature falls into a deep trance for 30 minutes. Every time 1 PotD is used(30 mins), they heal one wound of any stage and age backward by one day.

Plant an otherworldly cosmic seed that rapidly erupts into a gravity-defying alien blossom. The blossom creates a 3m zone of zero-gravity. Allies within the zone are infused with youthful vitality, instantly purging any poisons and treating their next action as if they spent 1 less PotD.
Perfectly remember anything you have personally studied, read or witnessed.
Ride the literal air currents around you, gaining a flying speed equal to your standard walking speed for the duration of the current combat encounter or scene.
Fire a single arrow that magically splits into radiant duplicates mid-air. Make one Attack Roll and apply the result against up to three clustered targets within Medium range(+1 creature = +1 PotD.
Domains: Hunt, War, Sky, Sun, Magic, Wrath

Rules: Manifest an instantaneous, shimmering arcane barrier that halves the final damage of one incoming magical attack targeting you or an adjacent ally.
Domains: Magic, Protection, Order, Void, Wisdom, Will

Rules: Summon a physical, glowing breeze that gently parts mundane(non magical) obstacles (like fog, smoke, or weak underbrush) and physically pulls you in the direction of a hidden objective or concealed door as the breeze brushes past you.
Domains: Travel, Fate, Wisdom, Air, Secrets, Fortune

Rules: Emit a sensory radar pulse. For one round, you ignore all penalties for fighting invisible or heavily obscured enemies and can clearly see the outlines of magical traps within Close range.
Vines or stone erupt beneath a target within Medium range. The target must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or become Immobilized until they spend a Major Action to physically break free.
Unleash a 5-meter radius explosion of your chosen element at a point within Far range. Enemies must pass a Dexterity save or take elemental damage according to the damage table.
Domains: Storms, Fire, Frost, Magic, Destruction, Wrath

Rules: Step through a tear in space, instantly teleporting to an unoccupied space you can clearly see within Medium range without triggering opportunity attacks or traps in between.
Link your lifeforce to an ally within Close range. For the next three rounds, whenever they take damage, you can choose to take half of that damage(rounded up) in their stead.

Imbue your weapon with potent toxins. Your successful attack inflicts a Poisoned condition in addition to its normal damage, causing the target to suffer Disadvantage on Constitution checks , it then makes a con save and if it fails it has disadvantage on saving throws until start of it's next turn
When targeted by a metallic projectile or a metal melee weapon, generate a sudden magnetic field that forces the attacker to reroll their Attack Roll and take the lower result.
Sing or shout a magical rallying cry. All allies within Medium range immediately recover from the Frightened or Charmed condition and gain resistance to their next incoming wound.
Force a creature that has just succeeded on an Attack Roll, Saving Throw or Ability Check to reroll the die. The new result must be used.
Choose one creature you can see within distant range, the next success that creature rolls is instead treated as a failure. You can use this feature equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Once per long rest declare preparations your character made before arriving. The preparation must be plausible and cannot contradict established events. The GM decides the exact details but the preparation is always partially successful.

Once per long rest, declare that you personally know an NPC relevant to the current problem. The NPC exists in the world and has a believable relationship with you. The GM determines their willingness and ability to help.
Domains: Civilization, Trade, Nobility, Wealth, Love, Travel

Rules: After any d20 is rolled but before narration begins, replace the die with a natural 10. This cannot affect another Threads of Destiny.
Once per long rest, when you would die, instead remain at Broken. You immediately gain one complete turn before collapsing unconscious.
Domains: Fate, Will, Life, Death, Valor, Strength

Rules: Call directly upon your divine parent. The GM narrates an intervention appropriate to their domains. This ability can never be relied upon to function identically twice.
Instantly heal one creature from Broken to Healthy, removing every wound. This cannot restore the dead. Gain 2 Fatigue after using this ability.
Domains: Healing, Life, Mercy, Love, Renewal, Peace

Rules: At the beginning of every combat, before Initiative, reposition every willing ally up to half their movement. This movement ignores weapon reach attacks.
While Unleashed, every successful attack you make counts as though it exceeded Defence by an additional 5 on the Damage Table.
Domains: War, Wrath, Valor, Strength, Glory, Vengeance

Rules: Once per long rest, you and nearby allies automatically escape mundane imprisonment, restraints or pursuit through a narratively reasonable means determined jointly by you and the GM.
Domains: Freedom, Travel, Air, Trickery, Luck, Fortune

Rules: Permanently reshape a major terrain feature within sight. Create cliffs, rivers, bridges, walls, sinkholes or similar structures appropriate to your domains.

Once per settlement declare that someone important already knows your name and deeds. The GM introduces an appropriate NPC whose attitude begins Friendly unless story circumstances make that impossible.
Domains: Glory, Nobility, Civilization, Trade, Love, Wealth

Rules: When an ally would suffer wounds, you instead suffer them. Reduce the Damage Table result by 5 before applying it to yourself.
Domains: Mercy, Protection, Love, Life, Blood, Valor

Rules: Every natural beast within a kilometer becomes temporarily friendly toward you unless magically compelled otherwise. They will assist however reasonably able, and may react to your calls if safe to do so.
Domains: Beasts, Nature, Wilderness, Hunt, Freedom, Growth

Rules: Once per long rest you can touch one willing character except for yourself, and this creature is naturally inclined to be supported by the public. This character has advantage on any checks it makes to convince groups of people (more than 5) that can understand it.
Domains: Civilization, Nobility, Law, Order, Glory, Wealth

Rules: While Unleashed, whenever you inflict 2 or more wounds with an attack, every adjacent creature must succeed on a Dexterity Saving Throw or become Prone from the devastation.
Once per long rest immediately remove all Fatigue from yourself.
Domains: Life, Renewal, Healing, Strength, Light, Sun

Rules: During downtime create a unique masterwork item with one permanent special property approved by the GM. Such items count as magical for the purposes of overcoming magic resistances.
Domains: Craft, Creation, Metal, Earth, Fire, Wealth

Rules: Once per long rest introduce one plausible object, machine or artifact into the current scene that your group reasonably had access to beforehand. The GM determines its exact limitations.
At the beginning of combat you may move one piece of terrain, create one piece of light cover, or declare one environmental feature that has always existed.
While Broken, you ignore all penalties associated with being Broken until the end of your next turn. Afterwards you immediately fall unconscious unless healed.
Temporarily use one Tier I or Tier II ability possessed by another willing demigod within sight until the end of the scene.
Animate the surrounding environment. Trees, roots, vines and wildlife hinder your enemies, causing all hostile creatures to treat the area as difficult terrain until the end of the encounter.
Challenge one creature. Until one of you falls, attacks made by anyone else against either duelist, and any creatures the duelists attack except each other, suffer Disadvantage.
Domains: War, Justice, Valor, Law, Strength, Vengeance

Rules: After any creature rolls a natural 20, change it into a natural 1, or vice versa. This ability may only be used once per long rest.
Immediately enter your Unleashed State without meeting its normal activation condition. At the end of the scene you automatically gain 3 Fatigue.
Domains: Valor, Wrath, Zeal, War, Strength, Vengeance

Rules: Create a temporary Safe Space that lasts until dawn. While inside, creatures cannot gain Fatigue, and PotD may be restored by completing a Ritual there. Any enemies attempting to enter this space must succeed on a wisdom save against your DC+10.
Domains: Hearth, Peace, Protection, Life, Light, Magic

Rules: Speak with divine authority. Every creature capable of hearing you must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to willingly interrupt, attack or speak over you until you finish your declaration.
During downtime, establish a permanent organization, guild, temple or settlement. It exists in the world thereafter and develops according to the campaign.
Once per long rest, ask the GM to describe a brief scene that occurred in your current location at any point in history. The vision is truthful but may omit context.

Once per day, trigger this when you take a 4th Wound (Dead). You refuse to pass on. You remain at the Broken state instead, and the creature that struck you immediately suffers 2 Wounds as your divine blood lashes out in retribution.
Domains: Death, Life, Souls, Will, Vengeance, Blood

Rules: Unleash a terrifying wave of necrotic or toxic energy. All hostile creatures within Far range must pass a Constitution save or immediately gain 2 levels of Fatigue and a Bloodied wound.

Target a Scale 1 or 2 mortal. They must pass a Wisdom save against your dc -5. On a failure, you take complete narrative and mechanical control of their actions and speech for the duration of the scene.
Activate at the start of your turn. You take two full, consecutive turns (Move, Major, Minor) before anyone else can act. At the end of your third turn, you immediately gain 2 levels of Fatigue.

Touch a mortal creature, they must make a Wisdom save. On a fail, you permanently and flawlessly alter their memory of the last 24 hours. They will fiercely rationalize any logical inconsistencies this creates in their mind.

Call down a devastating projectile targeting a Distant area. All creatures in a 10-meter radius must make a Dexterity Save. On a fail, they suffer 2 Wounds (ignoring Armor). On a success, they take 1 Wound. The terrain becomes difficult terrain.

Forge a supernatural pact between 2 willing(to a degree) creatures. If either creature breaks the exact wording of the pact, they immediately drop to a Broken wound state, regardless of their Scale or current health.
When you or an ally are targeted by a ranged attack or projectile, create a localized vortex. The projectile is redirected at another target of your choice within range.
Touch a creature to temporarily strip away the ravages of time, age, or magical decay. The target is restored to their prime physical state for the next 24 hours.
Target one non-magical object or mundane creature you can see. Your eyes go pitch black as the target is completely removed from existence, leaving no trace behind.

Create a massive, semi-solid wall of pressurized water. It provides full cover and pushes back any enemies that attempt to cross it with a force capable of knocking them Prone. This water moves over the battlefield(2 meters per round) and dissapates against large solid objects or after 20 meters.
Enemies within touch range of you feel as though they are at the bottom of the ocean. Their movement speed is halved, and they suffer disadvantage on all Strength-based checks.
Encase one creature in unmelting, supernatural frost. The target is frozen in time and space, becoming incapacitated until they or an ally succeed on a Strength check against your divine DC + 5.
You extinguish all light within a specific area, creating a zone of total, magical darkness that cannot be pierced by non-divine senses.
When an ally you share a bond with is downed in combat, you immediately gain the Unleashed state for one round.

You radiate an aura of such intense beauty that all creatures within sight must succeed on a Wisdom save or be unable to target you with harmful actions for the remainder of the scene or until you target them with an attack first.

Hum or whistle a melody that aligns the local reality. As long as you are capable of keeping the tune of your melody, you and all creatures within close range move through the world as if by divine ordinance. You have advantage on stealth checks, you can often find doors being held open, vehicles in conveniant places, and advantage on any checks to keep up your (non combat)momentum.
You draw the life energy out of a defeated enemy or withered plant, converting it into a potent essence that heals you or an ally for 2 Wounds and restores 1 PotD.

Requirement: Must be in your Unleashed State. You become a pure elemental manifestation of your primary or secondary domain if it matches one of the required domains. Gain total immunity to that element's damage, your attacks deal pure elemental damage, and you can move freely through related terrain (e.g., swimming through earth, walking on air).
Domains: Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Frost, Storms

Rules: Sprout majestic, tangible wings granting a flying speed triple your walking speed and perfect maneuverability for the duration of a combat encounter or one full hour of travel.
Domains: Sky, Glory, Light, Freedom, Travel, Nobility

Rules: Fire a projectile that aggressively tracks a specific target around corners and heavy cover. This attack ignores all cover bonuses, does not require line of sight, and automatically inflicts a Broken wound on a successful hit.
Domains: Hunt, Death, Vengeance, Magic, Fate, Ruin

Rules: Rip a hole in reality within Medium range. All creatures within 10 meters must pass a Constitution save or be pulled 5 meters toward the center. All other active magical effects in the area are immediately dispelled.
When an attack would inflict a fatal wound, you instead drop to the Broken state instead and blind the attacker with a flash of life energy. Can be used once per full rest
Domains: Life, Souls, Healing, Renewal, Light, Protection

Rules: Create a massive localized earthquake. All structures within Far range take heavy structural damage, and all grounded creatures in the area must pass a Dexterity save or fall Prone and suffer a wound from the violent tremors.
Domains: Earth, Chaos, Ruin, Destruction, Wrath, Nature

Rules: Force a non-divine creature to pass a Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, you take complete control of their actions for one round. They will not perform actions that guarantee their own immediate death.

Plunge the battlefield into absolute, magical darkness that even darkvision cannot pierce, except for you and designated allies. Enemies without a form of truesight suffer automatic Disadvantage on all attacks and saves while within the area, and allies who can see have advantage on attacks against them. Lasts for 3 rounds.
Domains: Sun, Moon, Darkness, Shadow, Void, Magic

Rules: Summon ethereal chains that bind up to three targets within Medium range. Targets must pass a Strength save or become Restrained and completely incapable of lying or using magical teleportation for 10 minutes.
